file_reviews.assessment: Full manuscript inspected. Section 3.5 establishes the operator-valued Schatten-1 classification under axioms P1-P4 (Theorem 3.1). Section 4.7 establishes the conditional unitary frame symmetry U(n)/PU(n) under complete positivity and state-cone preservation (Lemma 4.9 and Theorem 4.10). Section 5.1 derives the telescoping Schatten-p distinguishability bound across contractive path transport (Theorem 5.1). Section 5.4 derives the exact secular root comparison floor for the rank-one comparison operator and its Loewner bound transfer to the graph Laplacian (Proposition E.7e).

Claim ledger inspected. C2 (Theorem 3.1 Schatten-p classification under P1-P4), C12 (Theorem 4.10 and Lemma 4.9 unitary frame symmetry), C14 (Theorem 5.1 distinguishability path bound across Schatten-p), and C19 (Proposition E.7e exact comparison operator secular root characterization) verified.
Core implementation module inspected. Contains OperatorSchattenPModule with schatten_norm, verify_kadison_unitary_invariance, and operator coboundary methods.
Test suite inspected. Contains test_isomorphism_invariance_orbit_weights_3edge_path, test_schatten_kadison_unitary_invariance, and test_operator_total_schatten_p_norm.

claims.statement: Seminorms on operator-valued 1-cochains satisfying edge additivity (P1), faithfulness (P2), maximal bounded-linear functoriality (P3), and presheaf automorphism invariance (P4) are weighted Schatten-1 norms with orbit-constant weights.
dependencies: Presheaf on a finite complex with finite-dimensional Hilbert operator stalks B_1(H).
Axioms P1 (edge additivity), P2 (faithfulness), P3 (maximal bounded-linear functoriality), and P4 (automorphism invariance).
Banach space duality B_1(H)^* = B(H) and operator polar decomposition.
claims.limits: Applies to bounded linear maps on trace-class stalks; restricting functoriality to CPTP maps does not force the trace norm; automorphism invariance alone does not ensure uniform weights across distinct edge orbits.

claims.statement: Surjective trace-norm-preserving completely positive compositional automorphisms of B_1(C^n) preserving the positive state cone are unitary conjugations A -> U A U^*, yielding a conditional U(n)/PU(n) local frame symmetry.
dependencies: Finite-dimensional operator stalks B_1(C^n) equipped with trace norm.
Kadison-Sourour surjective linear isometry classification theorem.
Complete positivity excluding the matrix transpose branch for n >= 2.
State-cone positivity preservation forcing V = U^*.
claims.limits: Characterizes symmetries of admissible local frame changes on operator stalks; does not derive a physical gauge field, Yang-Mills dynamics, or spacetime geometry.

claims.statement: For operator-valued sections along a path with Schatten-p contractive restriction maps, the endpoint distinguishability is bounded by accumulated edge defects: ||rho_a - R_{b,a}(rho_b)||_{S_p} <= sum_{e in path} ||delta_e||_{S_p}.
dependencies: Path graph connecting nodes a and b with uniform local Hilbert space H.
Schatten-p contractivity of restriction operators along the path.
Triangle inequality in Schatten-p Banach space.
claims.limits: Requires contractive restriction channels; if restriction maps are expansive, the bound fails; operational quantum trace distance interpretation requires states to be preserved as normalized density operators.

claims.statement: For n >= 2, v_i >= 0, alpha > 0, and d_i = alpha + v_i, the secular equation F(t) = (alpha/n) sum_{i=1}^n (d_i - t)^(-1) = 1 has a unique root tau in [0, d_min) equal to lambda_min(alpha(I - P) + diag(v)), which lower-bounds lambda_min(L_0 + diag(v)) under L_0 >= alpha(I - P).
dependencies: Finite graph with n >= 2 vertices and spectral gap premise L_0 >= alpha(I - P) for alpha > 0.
Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz inequality on the comparison operator secular form.
claims.limits: Requires positive connectivity parameter alpha > 0 and nonnegative loads; does not identify the l^2 spectral defect lambda_0 with the l^1 quotient norm Phi_1; bound transfers via Loewner ordering but is generally strict for non-flat loads.
